dialogues.speaker: Aramani
dialogues.text: "Fine goods" for sale! Come take a look! "Great stuff at reasonable prices," "Buy now before they're all sold out!"

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll have some Aranara specialties.

dialogues.speaker: Aramani
dialogues.text: "Specialties"? I don't understand... But there are "fine goods."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Aranara... merchant?

dialogues.speaker: Aramani
dialogues.text: Huh... Why does Nara friend's expression look so strange?

dialogues.speaker: Aramani
dialogues.text: Don't Nara merchants speak like this...?

dialogues.speaker: Aramani
dialogues.text: Or is "Buy now before they're all sold out!" not available here?

dialogues.speaker: Aramani
dialogues.text: I don't understand. Nara merchants' talk, too strange.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Aramani
dialogues.text: Goodbye, Nara friend. "We look forward to seeing you again"?

dialogues.speaker: Aramani
dialogues.text: I made "a fortune" during Festival Utsava, and I want to have more happiness, so the next step is...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll have some fine goods.

dialogues.speaker: Aramani
dialogues.text: It's not called "fine goods" anymore. Aramani is now selling "specialties."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Aramani
dialogues.text: Goodbye, Nara friend. I hope you'll make "a fortune" too.

dialogues.speaker: Aramani
dialogues.text: Festival! Fun! Many "customers," many "sales"! "Don't miss out on a good sale!"

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's for sale?

dialogues.speaker: Aramani
dialogues.text: The big "sale" now is happiness from Festival Utsava! Nara friend, would you like some happiness?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Aramani
dialogues.text: Goodbye, Nara friend. I hope you have lots of happiness and lots of "sales"!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What is happiness?

dialogues.speaker: Aramani
dialogues.text: Happiness cannot be seen or touched, but fills the Vanarana during Festival Utsava... I understand. Happiness is brought by Nara friend!
